# StockUp

> StockUp (grocery price comparison app for Australia) is a free Australian
> app that compares grocery prices at Coles and Woolworths side-by-side,
> tracks price history, sends price-drop alerts, and splits your shopping by
> whichever store is cheaper. It tracks 30,000+ products at both supermarkets
> and refreshes every price every Wednesday, matching the supermarkets'
> weekly catalogue cycle.

StockUp is published by SpendWise Apps and is available on iOS and Android in
Australia. It is an independent product and is **not affiliated with,
endorsed by, or sponsored by Coles or Woolworths**.

## Free features

No sign-up is required - the app opens straight into price comparison.

- **Side-by-side price comparison** - every tracked product shows the Coles
  price and the Woolworths price together, with per-unit pricing so different
  pack sizes are comparable.
- **Specials and half-price browsing** - search the full catalogue or browse
  by category to find what is currently discounted at either chain.
- **List (the products you save so StockUp can watch their prices)** - with
  free price-drop alerts on your terms: any special, a strong discount, a
  percentage off, or a target dollar price, at one store or both.
- **Cart (this week's shop, split by cheapest store)** - StockUp splits your
  Cart between Coles and Woolworths so every item is bought where it is
  cheaper, and shows what the split saves.
- **Barcode scanning** - scan a product in store to pull up both prices.
- **Recent price history** - the last 30 days on any product.

## StockUp Premium ($4.99/month or $39.99/year, cancel anytime)

- **Full Price History** - the complete price record for any product.
- **Price Intelligence** - a buy-now-or-wait read based on each product's
  sale pattern.
- **Smart Shop** - for shopping in person. Pick the store you are standing
  in and StockUp pulls that store's live prices and stock, then turns your
  shop into a checklist. Finished shops are saved to Past Purchases. Live
  prices come from the retailer's own systems, not the physical shelf.
- **Quick Cart** - sends your Cart to your real Coles or Woolworths trolley.
  You sign in to the retailer on your own device, inside an in-app browser;
  StockUp never sees your password and never places the order. You review
  and check out yourself.
- **Past Purchases** - a savings ledger of what you bought and what you
  saved, shop after shop.
- **Ad-free experience.**

## What StockUp is not

- Not a coupon, voucher, points, or cashback app.
- Does not cover ALDI (it does not publish prices) or IGA (pricing varies
  store to store).
- Australia only; iOS and Android only; there is no web app.
- Never places orders and never sees retailer passwords.
- Not affiliated with Coles or Woolworths.
- Not a stock-market, investing, or inventory application.
